problem.statement: Test whether four synthetic service requests preserve status and reach the correct human queue.
problem.public_interest: Prevent silent loss or unsafe auto-routing of public-service requests.
evidence_refs: proposal.md#接力凭证协议与最小可复现切片

place.space_mode: simulated counter; no real service transaction
place.non_ai_path: printed service directory and staffed referral script

data.retention: delete the four synthetic records after the review packet is reproduced
data.deletion_verification: human reviewer records count before and after deletion

forbidden_actions: connect to a real service system
approve or reject a real request
abstention_conditions: topic outside the four synthetic fixtures

human_gate.decision_diff: Concept record permits schema-only sandbox reproduction and forbids any real transaction.

rights.notice: SANDBOX / SYNTHETIC DATA / NOT A PUBLIC SERVICE
rights.opt_out: no participation is required; printed directory remains available
rights.appeal: not applicable to synthetic tickets; report a schema issue to the human reviewer
rights.accessibility: plain-language printed fixture and keyboard-readable JSON are required
rights.deletion: all synthetic logs are deletable without loss of a public service record

operations.fallback: manual comparison with expected queue table
operations.maintenance_owner: unassigned concept role; must be named before any trial
operations.exit_asset_plan: delete sandbox log; retain only schema, empty fixture and review note

stop_conditions: any synthetic high-risk ticket is routed away from the expected human queue
human fallback cannot complete the fixture
evaluation.review_cycle: single sandbox review; a new receipt is required for every version

handoff.output_object: SandboxEvidence: schema-valid route log with human comparison
handoff.next_gate: independent human review before any limited trial

disclaimer: Synthetic, concept-only example. Schema validity is not evidence of service accuracy, legal compliance, public acceptance or deployment safety.
